safety_checks: Exact mint + pool re-verified on DexScreener (pairs_by_address) right before the order
Mint authority must be null (getAccountInfo jsonParsed)
Token-2022: no transfer fee, transfer hook, permanent delegate, non-transferable, frozen default state, pausable or confidential extensions
Top-10 holders ≤ 35% of supply on-chain (getTokenLargestAccounts; pool / bonding-curve vaults excluded)
RugCheck: dev < 5%, top-10 < 35%, no bundle / insider network ≥ 10%, LP ≥ 95% burned/locked 30d+
Honeypot: a Jupiter sell route must exist (impact ≤ 5%, returns ≥ 80%)
Live Jupiter buy quote: price impact ≤ 2%, round-trip fees + impact ≤ 5%
Chase guard: fresh 5m ≤ +25%, fresh price ≤ +15% vs scan; candle run-up ≤ +150% in 60m
Caps: ≤ 0.077 SOL per token, ≤ 0.19 SOL total exposure incl. pending orders, 0.01 SOL fee reserve, budget 0.385 SOL
One pending order per mint (duplicate-order lock); orders not recorded within 15 min are reconciled against the wallet

monitoring.cadence: every 5 min (routine memecoin-desk-check: monitor, then scan)

paper_sim.label: SIMULATED — paper trading replay, not real trades
caveats: SIMULATED on historical 1-min candles; not real fills or real quotes

Scanner signals, momentum (5m buys>sells) and holder concentration at the time could not be reconstructed for coins that never reached those stages; RugCheck/mint state is as of NOW (survivor bias both ways)

Dev-sell / LP-pull exits are not modelled. Drops between checks are only seen at the next check, and exits fill 1-3 min after it, so fast dumps gap through the -20% stop (live 2026-11-27: Fireball -27% within 4 min of entry, KITT -27% on a stop whose DexScreener mark still read -4.8%)
Token-account rent (0.00204 SOL) is paid at entry and, in the plan, reclaimed after the full exit
Price impact estimated from pool liquidity at sighting; SOL/USD held constant
One short, hot-market window; small n — treat as a sanity check, not a forecast
